explanation.en: “their library card number and a PIN” → PIN. Capital letters do not matter.
explanation.kk: «their library card number and a PIN» → PIN. Бас не кіші әріп маңызды емес.
explanation.ru: «their library card number and a PIN» → PIN. Регистр букв не важен.

explanation.en: “borrowed through a free app” → free app (“app” is also accepted).
explanation.kk: «borrowed through a free app» → free app (app да есептеледі).
explanation.ru: «borrowed through a free app» → free app (засчитывается и app).

explanation.en: “so there are never any late fees” → late fees. “Any late fees” is three words.
explanation.kk: «so there are never any late fees» → late fees. «Any late fees» — үш сөз, шектен асады.
explanation.ru: «so there are never any late fees» → late fees. «Any late fees» — три слова, больше лимита.

RT-GT-SUM-03-Q3.quote: so there are never any late fees

explanation.en: Because copies are limited, “popular titles often have a waiting list”. Answer: waiting list — two words, within the limit.
explanation.kk: Көшірме саны шектеулі болғандықтан, «popular titles often have a waiting list». Жауап waiting list — екі сөз, шектен аспайды.
explanation.ru: Из-за ограниченного числа копий «popular titles often have a waiting list». Ответ waiting list — два слова, в пределах лимита.

RT-GT-SUM-03-Q4.quote: popular titles often have a waiting list

explanation.en: Members are informed by email: “will receive an email when it becomes available”. “Told by” paraphrases “receive”, so the answer is email.
explanation.kk: Кітап дайын болғанда хат келеді: «will receive an email when it becomes available». «Told by» — «receive» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы, жауап email.
explanation.ru: О доступной книге сообщают письмом: «will receive an email when it becomes available». «Told by» пересказывает «receive», ответ email.

RT-GT-SUM-03-Q5.quote: will receive an email when it becomes available
